Acorn AZC211, Contemporary Cube Kitchen Cabinet Knob

This contemporary stainless steel cube knob is the perfect accent for any cabinet. Constructed out of stainless steel, the unexpected modern cube shape is an excellent way to add a chicness to any cabinet door; and since it is made by Acorn, you can be sure that it will last for many years to come. Comes with a brushed stainless steel finish. The Acorn AZC111 Modern Cabinet Knob measures 1 inch cubed.

Specifications for the Acorn AZC211 Absolute Zero Collection Modern Cube Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Length 1"
  • Width 1"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Available in polished stainless steel or brushed stainless steel.

Sold Individually
